purpose: Scan for cloud resources directly or indirectly reachable from the internet and produce a structured exposure report.
description: Audits internet-facing resources and network misconfigurations. Use for: network exposure audit, internet-reachable resources, open security groups, open NSGs, SSH/RDP open to internet, public RDS, public S3, internet-facing load balancers, IMDSv2, Lambda unauthenticated URLs, EKS public API server, OpenSearch public endpoint, VPC flow logs, Azure VM public ingress, Azure NSG findings, Azure PaaS public access. Supports raw or presentation format.
capabilities: detect EC2 instances with public IP and open inbound security group rules (SSH, RDP, 0.0.0.0/0)
find RDS instances with PubliclyAccessible=true and internet-facing ELBs without WAF
identify S3 buckets with public ACLs or bucket policies allowing anonymous access
check IMDSv2 enforcement and Lambda function URLs without authentication
audit Azure VMs, NSGs, PaaS services, and AKS for public network access
context_descriptions: security group and NSG rules — inbound rules with 0.0.0.0/0 on sensitive ports
public resource inventory — EC2, RDS, ELB, Lambda, EKS, OpenSearch with internet-facing config
storage public access — S3 ACLs, bucket policies, Azure storage public access settings
VPC configuration — internet gateway associations, public subnets, VPC flow log status
